constraints: The designated entry represents index module evaluation through its dependencies. Setup and exported calls are independent entries. Direct imports evaluate their own dependency graphs. The bulk import from reports supplies types only. Evidence in skill/scripts/src/index.ts:12–46,364–405 and skill/scripts/src/api/bulk-lookup.ts:8–11.

The Skill prescribes installing dependencies from scripts, configuring project-root .env, enabling Analytics Data, Search Console and Indexing APIs, and granting the service account access to the GA4 property and Search Console. The documented execution surfaces are the import example and the tsx invocation. The runtime settings module calls dotenv from the working directory. Evidence in skill/SKILL.md:8–51 and skill/scripts/src/config/settings.ts:5–9.

The Skill requires analysis, automatic timestamped JSON saves, then reading saved JSON and writing Markdown to results/summaries/ with data tables, trends and recommendations. This is a workflow obligation. The storage and summary diagnostics preserve the limits of the implementation evidence. Evidence in skill/SKILL.md:53–64,116–142.

Declared ranges and lockfile resolutions respectively are @google-analytics/data ^4.9.0 and 4.12.1, @googleapis/indexing ^6.0.1 and 6.0.1, @googleapis/searchconsole ^6.0.1 and 6.0.1, dotenv ^16.4.7 and 16.6.1, googleapis ^170.0.0 and 170.1.0, tsx ^4.19.2 and 4.21.0, and typescript ^5.7.2 and 5.9.3. The lockfile places google-auth-library 10.5.0 under googleapis and 9.15.1 at the root for the google-gax dependency chain. Evidence in skill/scripts/package.json:1–17, skill/scripts/package-lock.json:1–22,439–474,975–986,1352–1391,1401–1413,1546–1563,2332–2363 and skill/scripts/tsconfig.json:1–20.

Call summaries bind inputs at the calling instruction and return that invocation's value on normal completion. A call_getClient, call_getSearchConsoleClient or call_getIndexingClient reads its own live slot, returns the hit with its creation-time credential provenance, or validates and constructs a distinct handle on a miss. Successful creation sets that slot. Client validation tests property ID, email and key, including for Search Console and Indexing. A property or site read at a caller uses its own current settings read. Evidence in skill/scripts/src/core/client.ts:12–62,67–133 and skill/scripts/src/config/settings.ts:40–74.

call_runReport and await instructions targeting report wrappers inherit the report request, response selection and cache behavior. call_querySearchAnalytics and await instructions targeting Search Console wrappers inherit the Search Console request, response.data selection and cache behavior. These calls use the actual range bound at each site. A falsy range reads the current default when parsing, separately for each call. Default child saves use the actual child response or projection, its operation and the original date string when truthy. The comparison calls supply save false, and the realtime and metadata zero-argument calls retain save true. At analysis call sites, static progress logs in the source span precede the associated await. Evidence in skill/scripts/src/api/reports.ts:47–175, skill/scripts/src/api/searchConsole.ts:51–175, skill/scripts/src/api/realtime.ts:24–99, skill/scripts/src/api/metadata.ts:38–95 and skill/scripts/src/index.ts:55–295,355–361.

For call_saveResult, operands are data, category, operation and optional extraInfo in that order. Each call obtains its own settings and clock readings, creates the category directory if absent, and writes the wrapper to the derived path. Replace is the runtime abstraction for the write. Callers discard the returned path. The direct storage.save entry returns the path after successful write. The path can be reused by a later write with matching naming components. Evidence in skill/scripts/src/core/storage.ts:31–95 and the call sites.

Normal edges follow successful evaluation. An uncaught exception aborts the remaining actions and rejects an async call or throws from a synchronous call. In particular, client preparation can fail before the external request, an SDK request can reject after invocation, and a later save can fail after a successful response. Earlier successful SDK actions or writes can persist. Explicit outcome operands retain caught exceptions separately from normal values. In the two index.ts try summaries the push represented by the success successor is the try body's local update, and the summary's exceptional alternative includes exceptions from that source try body. Evidence in skill/scripts/src/index.ts:55–345, skill/scripts/src/api/indexing.ts:57–104,114–193 and skill/scripts/src/core/storage.ts:58–114.
